verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              विदुरस्य सुहृत्कश्चित्खनकः कुशलो नरः। विविक्ते पाण्डवान्राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : O king, a friend of Vidura, a person wellskilled in mining, came and spoke thus to the Pandavas in private.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहितो विदुरेणास्मि खनकः कुशलो ह्यहम्। पाण्डवानां प्रियं कार्यमिति किं करवाणि वः॥२॥
verses.english: "I have been sent by Vidura; I am wellskilled in mining. Tell me what favourite works of the Pandavas I shall perform. He trusts me and has said to me in private, “Go to Pandavas and accomplish their good. what can I do for you?

verses.sanskrit: प्रच्छन्नं विदुरेणोक्तः श्रेयस्त्वमिह पाण्डवान्। प्रतिपादय विश्वासादिति किं करवाणि वः॥३॥
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां रात्रावस्यां पुरोचनः। भवनस्य तव द्वारि प्रदास्यति हुताशनम्॥४॥
verses.english: Purochana will set fire to the door of your house on the night of the fourteenth day of the black fortnight.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रच्छन्नं यथास्यात्तथा पाण्डवान् श्रेयः प्रतिपादयेत्युक्तोहं वः किं करवाणि ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा सह प्रदग्धव्याः पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः। इति व्यवसितं तस्य धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः॥५॥
verses.english: The desire of the wicked-minded Dhritarashtra's son (Duryodhana) is to burn the best of men, the Pandavas, with their mother.

verses.sanskrit: किंचिच्च विदुरेणोक्तो म्लेच्छवाचासि पाण्डव। त्वया च तत्तथेत्युक्तमेतद्विश्वासकारणम्॥६॥
verses.english: O Pandavas, something was told to you by Vidura in the Mlecha language and you too replied in that language. I tell you this as a credential."

verses.sanskrit: उवाच तं सत्यधृतिः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। अभिजानामि सौम्य त्वां सुहृदं विदुरस्य वै॥७॥
verses.english: Yudhisthira said : Yudhisthira, the truthful son of Kunti, thus spoke to him. O amiable one, I now know you as a dear and trusted friend of Vidura, true and ever devoted to him. There is no necessity (of ours) which that learned man (Vidura) does not know.

verses.sanskrit: शुचिमाप्तं प्रियं चैव सदा च दृढभक्तिकम्। न विद्यते कवेः किंचिदविज्ञातं प्रयोजनम्॥८॥
यथा तस्य तथा नस्त्वं निर्विशेषा वयं त्वयि। भवतश्च यथा तस्य पालयास्मान्यथा कविः॥९॥
verses.english: As you are his, so you ours. Do not make any difference between him and us. We are as much yours as his. Protects us as that learned man (Vidura) protects us.

verses.sanskrit: इदं शरणमाग्नेयं मदर्थमिति मे मतिः। पुरोचनेन विहितं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥१०॥
verses.english: I know this inflammable house was built for me by Purochana at the command of the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana).
verses.bhavadeepa: यथा वयं तस्य तथा भवतश्च पालनीयाः । अतोस्मान्यथा कविः पालयति तथा त्वमपि पालयेत्यर्थः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: स पापः कोशवांश्चैव ससहायश्च दुर्मतिः। अस्मानपि च पापात्मा नित्यकालं प्रबाधते॥११॥
verses.english: That sinful, vicious and wicked-minded man, commanding wealth and allies, pursues us always (with his persecutions).

verses.sanskrit: स भवान्भोक्षयत्वस्मान्यत्नेनास्माद्धुताशनात्। अस्मास्विह हि दग्धेषु सकामः स्यात्सुयोधनः॥१२॥
verses.english: Save us with exertion from the impending conflagration. If we are brunt to death, the desire of Duryodhana will be fulfilled.

verses.sanskrit: समृद्धमायुधागारमिदं तस्य दुरात्मनः। वप्रान्तं निष्प्रतीकारमाश्रित्येदं कृतं महत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Here is that wicked man's well stocked arsenal. This large house has been built abutting the high walls of the arsenal, without having any out let. This most curse device which was made (for our destruction) was known to Vidura and I was told of it by him.

verses.sanskrit: इदं तदशुभं नूनं तस्य कर्म चिकीर्षितम्। प्रागेव विदुरो वेद तेनास्मानन्वबोधयत्॥१४॥
सेयमापदनुप्राप्ता क्षत्ता यां दृष्टवान्पुरा। पुरोचनस्याविदितानस्मांस्त्वं प्रतिमोचय॥१५॥
verses.english: The danger that Kshatta (Vidura) saw beforehand is now at our door, Save us from this without the knowledge of Purochana.

verses.sanskrit: स तथेति प्रतिश्रुत्य खनको यत्नमास्थितः। परिखामुत्किरन्नाम चकार च महाबिलम्॥१६॥
verses.english: The miner promised to do it by saying "Be it so"; and he began with care the work of excavation and he (soon) made a subterranean passage.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रे च वेश्मनस्तस्य मध्ये नातिमहद्बिलम्। कपाटयुक्तमज्ञातं समं भूम्याश्च भारत॥१७॥
verses.english: He made that subterranean passage in the centre of the house. O descendant of Bharata, it was in a level with the floor and closed up by doors (planks).
verses.bhavadeepa: परिखा प्राकारपरिधिभूतो गर्तः ताम् । नाम प्रसिद्धम् । उत्किरन्परिखापरिष्कारव्याजेन बिलान्मृदम् उत्किरन् बहिः क्षिपन् महाबिलं सुरङ्गाख्यं चकार ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: पुरोचनभयादेव व्यदधात्संवृतं मुखम्। स तस्य तु गृहद्वारि वसत्यशुभधीः सदा। तत्र ते सायुधाः सर्वे वसन्ति स्म क्षपां नृप॥१८॥
verses.english: For the fear of Purochana, its mouth was thus covered. He (Purochana) kept a constant watch at the gate of the house. O king, they the (Pandavas) lived in the night in it with arms ready for use; and in the day they hunted from forests to forests. Thus lived they very guardedly deceiving Purochana with a show of trustfulness and contentment while in reality they were trustless and discontented.

verses.sanskrit: दिवा चरन्ति मृगयां पाण्डवेया वनाद्वनम्। विश्वस्तवदविश्वस्ता वञ्चयन्तः पुरोचनम्। अतुष्टा तुष्टवद्राजन्नूषुः परमविस्मिताः॥१९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यदधात् विहितवान् । स पुरोचनस्ते च पञ्च गृहद्वारि क्षपां वसन्ति स्म ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: न चैनानन्वबुध्यन्त नरा नगरवासिनः। अन्यत्र विदुरामात्यात्तस्मात्खनकसत्तमात्॥२०॥
verses.english: The people of the city also did not know anything of these plans (of the Pandavas). Except the friend of Vidura, that good miner, none else knew anything.
verses.bhavadeepa: दिवा च मृगयां चरन्ति अतो न दग्धुं पुरोचनश्छिद्रं प्रापेति भावः ॥१९॥
